C1190.title: Capital One Data Breach Caused by Cloud Misconfiguration
C1190.summary: In 2019, a cloud infrastructure misconfiguration at Capital One, including improperly set storage bucket permissions, exposed the personal data of over 100 million customers. The incident became a landmark case of how cloud configuration flaws can lead to severe consequences, highlighting the critical importance of IAM permission management and storage security.
